items.title: A V-admissible blowup makes the strict transform an isomorphism along the closure of T
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Separate T from the non-isomorphism locus T' by constructible closed supersets in the spectral space |V| (quasi-compact open W containing T' and missing T, etc.), separate their closures by lemma-separate-disjoint-locally-closed-by-blowing-up; on the open Y_0 = Y \ closure(T'_c) the morphism is already an isomorphism, so the Zariski-after-blowup lemma gives a V_0-admissible blowup Y'_0 with X'_0 ≅ Y'_0, and the extend-admissible-blowups lemma glues it to a global V-admissible blowup whose strict transform restricts to that isomorphism.
